title: Expected Signature Kernels for Rough Paths
abstract: arXiv:2509.07893v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The expected signature kernel is a similarity measure of probability laws on path space and enters directly into signature maximum mean discrepancies. Building on [P. K. Friz, P. P. Hager, and N. Tapia, Forum Math. Sigma, 10 (2022), e42] and [M. Lemercier, T. Lyons, and C. Salvi, SIAM J. Numer. Anal., 64 (2026), pp. 1095-1125], we characterize the expected signature kernel of group-valued inhomogeneous L\'evy processes, aka L\'evy rough paths, as the scalar component of the solution to an extended Goursat-type system. We give an original description, first in the continuous case where the finite-dimensional system is exact. In the presence of jumps, this system is inherently infinite-dimensional; we prove its well-posedness and derive finite-dimensional truncations with explicit error control. This permits direct evaluation of the reference-dependent terms in one-sample signature-MMD tests without an auxiliary reference sample.

translated_title: 粗糙路径的期望签名核
translated_abstract: 期望签名核是路径空间上概率律的一种相似性度量，并直接应用于签名最大均值差异中。基于 Friz、Hager 和 Tapia（Forum Math. Sigma, 2022）以及 Lemercier、Lyons 和 Salvi（SIAM J. Numer. Anal., 2026）的工作，我们将群值非齐次Lévy过程（又称Lévy粗糙路径）的期望签名核刻画为一个扩展Goursat型方程组解的标量分量。我们给出了一个原创性的描述：首先在连续情形下，该有限维方程组是精确的；而在存在跳跃的情形下，该方程组本质上是无限维的，我们证明了其适定性，并推导出具有显式误差控制的有限维截断。这使得在单样本签名-MMD检验中，无需辅助参考样本即可直接计算依赖于参考的项。
tldr: 本文将Lévy粗糙路径的期望签名核刻画为扩展Goursat型方程组解的标量分量，证明了跳跃情形下无限维系统的适定性并给出显式误差控制的有限维截断，从而无需辅助参考样本即可直接计算单样本签名-MMD检验中的参考依赖项。
en_tdlr: This paper characterizes the expected signature kernel of Lévy rough paths as the scalar component of an extended Goursat-type system, proves well-posedness of the infinite-dimensional system in the jump case with explicitly error-controlled finite-dimensional truncations, enabling direct evaluation of reference-dependent terms in one-sample signature-MMD tests without an auxiliary reference sample.
